crossRefs.note: Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, “When you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,
Abram passed through the land to the place of Shechem, to the oak of Moreh. At that time, Canaanites were in the land.
Yahweh appeared to Abram and said, “I will give this land to your offspring.” He built an altar there to Yahweh, who…
for I will give all the land which you see to you and to your offspring forever.
In the fourth generation they will come here again, for the iniquity of the Amorite is not yet full.”
I will give to you, and to your offspring after you, the land where you are traveling, all the land of Canaan, for an…
Turn, and take your journey, and go to the hill country of the Amorites and to all the places near there: in the…
Behold, I have set the land before you. Go in and possess the land which Yahweh swore to your fathers—to Abraham, to…
He also drove out the nations before them, allotted them for an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to…
saying, “To you I will give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance,”
You shall inherit it, one as well as another; for I swore to give it to your fathers. This land will fall to you for…
He made from one blood every nation of men to dwell on all the surface of the earth, having determined appointed…
Yahweh assigned my portion and my cup. You made my lot secure.
The lines have fallen to me in pleasant places. Yes, I have a good inheritance.
“But I said, ‘How I desire to put you among the children, and give you a pleasant land, a goodly heritage of the armies…
to open their eyes, that they may turn from darkness to light and from the power of Satan to God, that they may receive…
who is a pledge of our inheritance, to the redemption of God’s own possession, to the praise of his glory.
having the eyes of your hearts enlightened, that you may know what is the hope of his calling, and what are the riches…
Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy caused us to be born again to…
to an incorruptible and undefiled inheritance that doesn’t fade away, reserved in Heaven for you,

people.name: Canaan
people.line: Ancient region; descendants of Ham; promised to Abraham's descendants

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes
